title: Paws of the Bear
content:
# Paws of the Bear

Internal ID: FistBjornClaw | Type: Fists | Source: Workbench | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Bear hide x6, Leather scraps x6 | Attack speed: 1.48 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2 range, 1 height, 0.3 ray

# Introduction

Paws of the Bear is the first craftable fist weapon.
The primary attack is a 2-hit combo with 2x damage at the second hit. The secondary attack is a kick which does additional knockback and 6x staggering.
It deals 6x damage against unalerted enemies.

## Trivia

• The secondary attack is enough to stagger most creatures
• Paws of the Bear like other fist weapons are the most durable of any weapon in the game by having durability value of 450 at max level.
